tasks.text: Establish the Pupil comparison geometry and performance targets, locate the electronics-envelope reference, and define the under-one-gram mass boundary.
Build a component-by-component mass and space budget for R10, including optics, board materials, connectors, strain relief and tether mass versus length, with uncertainty recorded.
Compare cost-conscious and premium compact constructions, including thin rigid boards, locally stiffened flex and rigid-flex, and identify the changes with the greatest size and mass benefit.
Create dimensioned packaging studies beside the Pupil reference, checking component packing, lens support and tether routing without replacing the verified R10 circuit.
Save a recommendation showing achievable size and estimated mass ranges, cost assumptions, remaining uncertainties and the constraints for the subsequent electrical revision.
